parallelism.description: Degree of parallelism. 0 or empty means full parallelism.

iorate.description: I/O weighting factor. Processes blocked by pending I/O are weighted by this factor.

global_timeout.description: Global timeout in seconds. If no output is printed for this long, oldest script buffer is flushed.

script_timeout.description: Script buffer timeout in seconds. Flushes buffer if no output for this duration.

prefix_name.description: If true, prefixes output with the program/script name.

script_arg.description: Argument passed to all runlevel scripts.

etc_dir.description: Location of the system's etc configuration directory.
